acceptance: ASan/UBSan dsdgen runs cover SF 0.01, SF 1 base and refresh sets 1-4 at SF 0.01, SF 1 and SF 10 for two seeds; every report is either fixed, filed as its own item with file/line evidence, or explained in context.

A test generates the SF 1 refresh sets and the base dimensions they reference and fails if any refresh foreign business key is missing from its dimension or any return lacks a matching ordered line, for store, catalog and web channels; it runs in CI.
That integrity test fails when pointed at the pre-fix binary (the one shipped before #4426) and passes on the current bundled binary.
SF 1 refresh sets 1 and 2 from all six bundled binaries are compared and the result is recorded; any non-identical platform has its own item.
context: Priority high because undetected generator UB changes benchmark data per platform without any error, and the monthly seed corpus publishes TPC-DS SF 1 results. Evidence for the class of bug: nightly runs 44832232783 (CedarDB LF_WR NOT NULL failure) and 45050812378 (pass after fix).
description:
## Problem
The web lineitem item-wrap bug (fixed in #4429/#4426) was an out-of-bounds read in `dsdgen` that silently produced different data per platform. It was found only because CedarDB rejected the Linux data at SF 1; macOS produced plausible duplicates and ClickHouse stored default keys without error. Nothing systematic checks `dsdgen` for other undefined behaviour or checks refresh data for referential integrity, so a sibling defect could still corrupt published results unnoticed. The new regression test covers only `s_web_order_lineitem` and `s_web_returns`.

## Scope
1. Build `dsdgen` from the tracked patch set (`_sources/tpc-ds/REBUILD.md`) with `-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer` on Linux, and run: SF 0.01 and SF 1 base data; refresh sets 1-4 at SF 0.01, SF 1 and SF 10; seed 20260709 and one other seed. Record every sanitizer report with file, line and the table being generated.
2. Add a referential-integrity check over the generated SF 1 refresh sets for every source table that carries a foreign business key (store, catalog and web lineitems and returns, purchases, inventory): each key must exist in the generated base dimension, and each return must match an ordered line.
3. Compare refresh output of the six bundled binaries at SF 1 (they must be byte-identical apart from `dbgen_version`).

## Decision gate (owner)
Each confirmed defect gets its own tracker item. Before any fix that changes generated data, the owner decides whether to accept the data change and how results record it (results generated before and after are not comparable).

## Guardrails
- Investigation and test additions only in this item; data-changing dsdgen fixes go in their own items after the decision gate.
- No BenchBox-side filtering or repair of generated rows.
- Sanitizer builds are diagnostic only and are never shipped.
- Heavy runs go through `make heavy-run` or `make ci-linux`.

## Verification rubric
- Sanitizer log for every listed scale/set/seed combination, attached or summarised in context, with zero unexplained reports or one item per finding.
- The integrity check runs in CI (medium tier or nightly) and fails on the pre-fix binary from 0182c9556c for web returns.
- Cross-platform refresh comparison result recorded for all six binaries.
